description:
Replace the provider/model split with one selection model and a pure resolver the UI and pipeline both use.

Today: Settings.provider: ProviderKind ("local" | "soniox", packages/domain/src/recording.ts:56) picks the live path, and ModelSelection (packages/domain/src/models.ts) holds local catalog ids plus specials ("off", "same-as-live", "cloud" summary). Soniox-ness leaks as string checks: post-processor.ts:223 and :262, controller.ts:195, LiveView.tsx:13/42/62, RecordingView.tsx:205/223, services.ts:155.

Build (packages/domain):
- A service option type next to ModelCatalogEntry: { id ("soniox:stt-rt-v5", "speechmatics:enhanced", "speechmatics:voice-id", "cloud-summary"), roles, service ("soniox" | "speechmatics" | "summary-endpoint"), execution: "cloud", languages, provides: Partial<Record<ModelRole, note>>, requires: { secret?: SecretName, roleService?: {roles, service} } }. Local catalog entries stay as they are.
- resolveSelection(selection, { hasSecret, language, caps }) -> per role: { effectiveId, locked: null | { by: optionId, label: "Provided by Soniox" }, options: [{id, disabled: null | reason}] }. Pure, unit-tested.
- Capability rules (initial):
  - live = Soniox RT or Speechmatics RT: vad locked (service endpointing), stt-final locked (final tokens are the transcript; mirrors post-processor.ts:223). Voice model stays selectable (local embeddings on service ranges, as fuseSoniox does today).
  - live = off/local and final = cloud batch: vad stays for live local; if live is off, vad locked by the batch service.
  - voice model = speechmatics:voice-id: requires Speechmatics in stt-live or stt-final; local match policy doesn't apply.
  - summary options unchanged ("cloud" becomes the cloud-summary option; endpoint address still in settings).
- SecretStore names become a union (soniox_api_key | speechmatics_api_key), packages/domain/src/settings.ts SecretStore and packages/storage/src/secrets.ts.
- Settings migration: provider "soniox" -> models.sttLive = "soniox:<sonioxModel>"; drop Settings.provider (keep Recording.provider for history, derived from the resolved live option at start). sonioxModel folds into the option id.
- Recording snapshots the resolved selection (incl. locks) so reprocessing and history labels don't re-derive from current settings.

Done when: resolver tests cover the rules above incl. "no key", "language unsupported", and old-settings migration; no behavior change yet for existing local/Soniox users.
title: Selection registry: cloud options, capability rules, resolver
